source: Progress through your Heart of the Forest by gaining HOTF Exp from Tree Gifts and during Starlyn Contests!
loreParagraphs.translation: 通过从树木礼物和斯塔林竞赛中获得森林之心经验，来推进你的森林之心！

source: Every SkyBlock day, you gain a random effect while on any Foraging Island.
loreParagraphs.translation: 每个空岛日，你在任意采伐岛屿上时都会获得一个随机效果。

source: Your Throwing Axes gain permanent homing abilities towards trees on Galatea.
loreParagraphs.translation: 你的投掷斧在 Galatea 上获得对树木的永久追踪能力。

source: Axe Abilities apply to all of your Axes. You can select an Axe Ability from your Heart of the Forest.
loreParagraphs.translation: 斧技能适用于你的所有斧。你可以从森林之心中选择一个斧技能。

source: Upgrade your Axe Abilities by unlocking Center of the Forest in this menu!
loreParagraphs.translation: 在此菜单中解锁森林中心以升级你的斧技能！

source: The first Tree Gift you obtain every day will contain a Basic Safari Ticket.
loreParagraphs.translation: 你每天获得的第一份树木礼物将包含一张基础狩猎旅行券。

source: Every SkyBlock day, you receive a random effect.
loreParagraphs.translation: 每个空岛日，你都会获得一个随机效果。

source: You have unlocked this tier. All perks and abilities on this tier are available for unlocking with Token of the Forest.
loreParagraphs.translation: 你已解锁此层级。此层级上的所有特权和能力均可使用森林之证解锁。
在已保存的树木之间快速切换。

source: Gain Tokens of the Forest by leveling up your Heart of the Forest tiers.
loreParagraphs.translation: 通过提升你的森林之心层级来获得森林之证。

source: Forest Whispers Forest Whispers are dropped from Fig and Mangrove Tree Gifts on the Moonglade Marsh.
loreParagraphs.translation: 森林低语 森林低语由月光林地沼泽上的无花果树和红树林树木礼物掉落。

source: Desert Whispers Desert Whispers are dropped from Helix Tree Gifts on Torrhus Canyon.
loreParagraphs.translation: 沙漠低语 沙漠低语由托尔胡斯峡谷上的螺旋树树木礼物掉落。

source: Welcome to the Moonglade Marsh, the first island of Galatea.
loreParagraphs.translation: 欢迎来到月光林地沼泽，加拉提亚的第一座岛屿。

source: Here you'll learn about Hunting, advanced Foraging, and maybe even discover the secrets of the island!
loreParagraphs.translation: 在这里你将了解狩猎、高级采伐，甚至可能发现这座岛屿的秘密！

source: Torrhus Canyon is the second island of Galatea.
loreParagraphs.translation: 托尔胡斯峡谷是加拉提亚的第二座岛屿。

source: Here you'll continue to hone your Foraging and Hunting skills as you partake in Miria's Contests, explore the Critter Safari, and dive deep into Torrhus Springs.
loreParagraphs.translation: 在这里，你将参加米莉亚的竞赛、探索生物狩猎、深入托尔胡斯温泉，继续磨练你的采伐和狩猎技能。

source: You have unlocked this tier. All perks and abilities on this tier are available for unlocking with Token of the Mountain.
loreParagraphs.translation: 你已解锁此层级。此层级的所有增益和技能均可使用山脉之证解锁。

source: Pickaxe Abilities apply to all of your Pickaxes. You can select a Pickaxe Ability from your Heart of the Mountain.
loreParagraphs.translation: 镐技能适用于你的所有镐。你可以从山脉之心中选择一个镐技能。

source: Upgrade your Pickaxe Abilities by unlocking Core of the Mountain in this menu!
loreParagraphs.translation: 在此菜单中解锁山脉核心，以升级你的镐技能！

source: Every time you enter a Glacite Mineshaft, you receive a random buff.
loreParagraphs.translation: 每次进入冰川矿井时，你都会获得一个随机增益。

source: Every SkyBlock day, you receive a random buff while on any Mining Island.
loreParagraphs.translation: 每个空岛日，你在任何采矿岛屿上都会获得一个随机增益。

source: Rare occurrences include: • Golden Goblins • Fallen Stars • Powder Ghasts
loreParagraphs.translation: 稀有事件包括：• 黄金哥布林 • 坠落之星 • 粉末恶魂

source: Unlock more Token of the Mountain by leveling up your Heart of the Mountain tiers.
loreParagraphs.translation: 提升山之心层级以解锁更多山之证。

source: Obtain Mithril Powder by mining and taking part in events in the Dwarven Mines. Obtain Gemstone Powder by mining Gemstones and opening Treasure Chests in the Crystal Hollows. Obtain Glacite Powder by mining Glacite and looting Frozen Corpses in the Glacite Tunnels.
loreParagraphs.translation: 在矮人矿井中挖矿和参与活动可获得秘银粉。在晶洞中开采宝石和开启宝箱可获得宝石粉。在冰晶隧道中开采冰晶和搜刮冰冻尸体可获得冰晶粉。

source: Increase your chance to gain extra Powder by unlocking perks, equipping the Mithril Golem Pet, and more!
loreParagraphs.translation: 通过解锁技能、装备秘银傀儡宠物等方式提高获得额外粉的概率！

source: Crystals are used to forge Gems into Perfect Gems. They can be found hidden within the Crystal Hollows.
loreParagraphs.translation: 水晶用于将宝石锻造成完美宝石。它们隐藏在晶洞之中。

loreParagraphs.translation: 你将保留已解锁的所有层级和山之心核心。

loreParagraphs.translation: 警告：此操作永久生效。重置山之心后无法撤销！

loreParagraphs.translation: 被著名疯狂科学家基因改造的狂犬。吃骨头和肉。

source: Even demons fear this incarnation of pure evil, constantly feeding on its burning desire for destruction.
